mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q01.stem: May old-procedure experience ngunit nagbago ang work. Ano bago simulan?
options: Tiyakin ang changed hazards, training, at authority
reasons: Hindi garantiya ng new training/permission ang old experience.
Gawin ang permitted work matapos hazard at scope checks.
Hindi basis ng unverified operation.
Itanong bago start ang unknown.

mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q02.stem: Angkop na safety check matapos anti-slip installation?
options: Tiyakin ang slip reduction at bagong step hazards
reasons: Hindi effect o residual-risk proof ang installation.
Small events ay improvement information din.
Hindi effect evidence ang deletion.
Suriin ang original hazard at side effects.

mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q03.stem: Corrosion pictogram sa chemical container. Angkop na handling-condition check?
options: Product, cautions, SDS, at workplace procedure
Same picture, same gloves sa lahat
reasons: Iugnay ang pictogram sa specific product at procedure.
Iba ang material at concentration conditions.
Dangerous ang direct unknown-substance check.
Hindi one-symbol ang pag-exclude sa ibang hazards.

mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q04.stem: Unknown calibration ngunit may JISmark. Angkop na judgment?
options: Tiyakin ang scope at current management
Same method sa lahat ng material
reasons: Hindi individual-product test pass ang mark.
Kailangan pa rin ang damage/calibration check.
Ihiwalay ang mark meaning at current compatibility/control.
Kailangan ang target compatibility.

mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q05.stem: Compatible approved returnable-box repeated use:alin sa 3R?
options: Recycle na laging sinisira ang shape
reasons: Ang same-item repeated use ay reuse.
Iba ang repeat at resource recycling.
Hindi chemical mixing.
Reuse ang repeated use na sumusunod sa approval.

options: Hindi name lamang ang pHo harmlessness
Lahat metal salts tulad ng food
reasons: Kahit normal salt, ayon sa combination ang solution.
Ihiwalay ang formula classification sa actual properties/safety.
Tiyakin ang components/concentration hazards.
Kailangan ang identification at compatibility.

mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q07.stem: Sa pagsama ngFe→Fe²⁺+2e⁻at Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu, ano ang angkop?
options: Magdagdag ng extra electrons sa both sides
Itugma ang electrons at tiyakin ang atoms/charge
reasons: Itugma upang magkansela ang transfer.
Oxidation ang release; reduction ang acceptance.
Tiyakin ang whole-reaction balance.
Redox ito, iba sa neutralization.

mfg1-surface-weekly-07-q08.stem: KYTgoal ay mag-ingat lamang. Angkop na improvement?
options: Linawin kung sino, saang situation, anong action/check
Alisin lahat ng equipment measures nang hindi balik sa discovery
reasons: Iugnay sa executable team action at verification.
Hindi dahilan upang alisin ang needed measures.
Hindi safety-device substitute ang caution.
Tiyakin ang execution at effect ng goal.

options: Gamitin upang pahalagahan ang small-hazard reporting at measures
reasons: Hindi universal probability guarantee.
Iugnay sa prevention, hindi mechanical forecast.
Hindi no-accident-count guarantee.
Huwag baguhin ang actual facts.
One-thousandth angm.
Baligtad ang conversion.
Hindi one-digit transformation.

options: Total waste lamang kahit iba ang production
Same conditions, pati use amount at defect impacts
Alisin lahat ng protective packaging nang walang approval
reasons: Isaalang-alang ang count at period differences.
Hindi effect indicator ang color.
Tiyakin ang quality, safety, at before/after process effects bukod sa resources.
Kailangan ang approval at compatibility sa needed protection change.

options: Hindi nagbabago ang oxidation numbers sa neutralization na ito
Laging metal deposit kung water formation
No color change, no chemical reaction
reasons: Ihiwalay sa oxidation-number change at transfer.
Huwag itumbas ang neutralization at metal deposit.
Hindi appearance lamang ang presence ng reaction.
Oxidation ang electron loss.
